title: Wooden Sanguine - Stats, Combo & How to Get (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: Wooden Sanguine in Phantom Blade Zero - weapon class, slot, stats, combo contribution and how to obtain it, with unconfirmed numbers left marked as unconfirmed.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Wooden Sanguine is a one-handed blade in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Soul's childhood blade. It is the tutorial weapon and the one the story opens with, not a placeholder to be thrown away.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Wooden Sanguine occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as One-handed. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not publish a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons, and no measurement of this one has been recorded, so no damage, scaling or speed figure is given here. A number invented from how the weapon looks is exactly the kind of filler this page exists to avoid.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. No verified note on how this weapon behaves inside a combo has been published, so nothing is written here.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Story reward - Soul's childhood blade.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page tracks Wooden Sanguine in Phantom Blade Zero. Anything marked “not confirmed post-launch” has not been published or measured yet; see the weapons list for the system as a whole.
